context.p: Trimming removes unwanted audio from the beginning, end, or middle of your recording. This is useful for cutting out silence, false starts, or mistakes.

step.cmd: Press the Delete key to remove the selected audio.

info.p:
The audio after the deleted region shifts left to close the gap. If you want to replace the selection with silence instead (keeping the timing), use
Edit Remove Special Silence Audio .

step.cmd: Listen to the result by pressing Space to play.

result.p: The unwanted audio has been removed from your track.
